page.overview:
Who is Tracker?

While Tracker is relaxing at the beach, a Red Shadows agent identifies and kills him (despite not having appeared in any previous comic issue, it's implied that Tracker was a former G.I. Joe member).

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

Tracker's only action figure was among the 1991 single-carded series of the A Real American Hero toys. The body was an all-original mold. ---- Appearance: brown hair; red sleeveless shirt with "Joe 34" on chest and "Groen 34" on back; black holster and gloves; yellow pants with black holster and white leg bands; yellow and purple boots.

Accessories: black visor; orange MP5K submachine gun; inflatable orange and black raft; two orange oars with paddle on one side; black figure stand. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/91/tracker.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/91/tracker.shtml Filecard]
